full_page.content:
1947, August 4
Mrs. John McCloskey
Page 2
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of a typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, 0. F. M. Cap.
Detroit - Royal Oak rather - on returning whic added about 375 miles or more of a trip. One of our convert Jews -- very clever who we hope will be a priest some day - drove me down from Detroit.
We had quite a nice little visit yesterday and Saturday- evening. They all seemed to have enjoyed it. Fr. John had to be back this morning for his classes. So they left about 5 p. m. yesterday.
I am sending you a couple of letters I think will interest you; as also a photo taken a little over a year ago. Of course its younger than the original. Anyhow I hope it may not disap- oint or scandalize
With love to all I beg to remain,
In the Sacred Heart of Jesus:
Your Brother
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original in possession of:
Eileen Mccluskey Daly (Mrs. James E. ) 1629 - 22nd Avenue
Longview, Wa. 98632
